name: strands-agents-demo-sample-for-aws
description: Interactive demo showcase for the Strands Agents framework on AWS: 11 live AI agent demos (agent loop, hooks and guardrails, human-in-the-loop, observability, swarm, graph, memory safety, chaos testing), each on its own Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, with a real-time under-the-hood UI. Deployed with AWS CDK.

paragraphs: An interactive, event-booth-ready web app that shows off the Strands Agents framework: a chat on the left, and a live "under the hood" panel on the right that visualizes what the agent is actually doing in real time (cycles, tool calls, blocked actions, handoffs, and token usage).

Every demo runs on its own Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime, deployed with AWS CDK. The browser talks to the agents through AWS AppSync Events (serverless WebSockets) secured with Amazon Cognito. The UI ships in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

💡 This sample uses Strands Agents. The same patterns are general agent concepts and carry over to other agent frameworks. ⚠️ This guide assumes familiarity with AWS CDK, Python, and TypeScript/React basics. New to the stack? Jump to Quick Start; one script deploys everything.

requirements.text: Credentials configured for the target account, for example via aws configure, AWSPROFILE, or SSO.
For Claude Haiku (the second model option in the UI), Anthropic requires a one-time first invocation from a user with AWS Marketplace permissions before the model is available account-wide.
